title: Evening Classes at the Community Centre
instructions: Read the descriptions of five people (1–5) and the advertisements (A–G). Choose the advertisement that best matches each person's needs. There are two extra advertisements. Use each advertisement only once.

blocks.title: A. Cooking for Beginners
blocks.text: Tuesday evenings, 6–8 pm. Learn to prepare 20 simple, healthy dishes. All ingredients are provided. No experience necessary.

blocks.title: B. Photography Walk
blocks.text: Saturday mornings. Bring your own camera or phone and learn how to take better pictures of city life. Free for students under 18.

blocks.title: C. Conversation Club
blocks.text: Thursdays at 7 pm. Practise speaking English with friendly volunteers. The club is free. Just come and talk!

blocks.title: D. Yoga for Busy People
blocks.text: Short 30-minute classes at lunchtime, Monday to Friday, 12:30. Mats are available. Perfect for office workers who want to relax during the working day.

blocks.title: E. Computer Skills for Seniors
blocks.text: Wednesday afternoons. Learn to use email, make video calls and shop online. Small groups and patient teachers.

blocks.title: F. Kids' Art Workshop
blocks.text: Sundays at 10 am. Painting and drawing for children aged 6–12. Parents can enjoy a coffee in our café while they wait.

blocks.title: G. Beginner Guitar
blocks.text: Friday evenings, group lessons of eight students. Guitars can be rented from us for a small fee, so you don't need to buy one.

questions.q: Dilnoza works in an office in the city centre and has only a short break at lunchtime. She wants to do some exercise to reduce her stress.
questions.why: Yoga for Busy People — tushlikda 30 daqiqalik darslar, ofis xodimlari uchun.

questions.q: Bobur is 17 and loves photography, but he has no money to spend on his hobby.
questions.why: Photography Walk — 18 yoshgacha talabalar uchun bepul.

questions.q: Mr Karimov, who is 68, wants to talk to his grandchildren abroad using a laptop.
questions.why: Computer Skills for Seniors — video qo'ng'iroq qilishni o'rgatadi.

questions.q: Malika wants to improve her spoken English, but she cannot afford to pay for lessons.
questions.why: Conversation Club — bepul, ingliz tilida gaplashish.

questions.q: Anvar wants to learn to play music, but he does not own an instrument.
questions.why: Beginner Guitar — gitarani ijaraga olish mumkin.
